data.one_liner: Large collection of String functions extending the String class and supporting nullable Strings safely.
data.what_it_does: The Strings package provides over 50 functions to complement the core String class. It extends String with helper methods and safely handles nullable strings without throwing errors.
use_when: You need safe string operations that handle null values without throwing exceptions.
You want to use helper methods like affix removal, partition, and whitespace normalization.
avoid_when: You need complex regular expression or Unicode normalization matching.
strengths: Never throws or returns errors on null inputs, making it robust.
Provides both static methods and String extension methods.
weaknesses: Matching is strictly literal, case-sensitive UTF-16 without regex support.
